<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Get Vehicles</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(request, response) {
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_snc_vehicles_api_vehicle');
    
    var make = request.queryParams.make;
    var year = request.queryParams.year;
    if (make) gr.addQuery('make', make);
    if (year) gr.addQuery('year', year);
    if (country) gr.addQuery('country', country);
    
    gr.query();
    
    var results = [];
    while (gr.next()) {
        results.push({
            make: gr.getValue('make'),
            model: gr.getValue('model'),
            vin: gr.getValue('vin'),
            year: gr.getValue('year'),
            country: gr.getValue('country')
        });
    }
    
    return { vehicles: results };
})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_snc_vehicles_api/vehicles_api/vehicles</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/vehicles</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-01 10:53:07</sys_created_on><sys_id>aa3cf784c311c3905c158e25990131f3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get Vehicles</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Vehicles API" source="x_snc_vehicles_api">a3683ce7c38587505b4efadf050131cd</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Vehicles API">a3683ce7c38587505b4efadf050131cd</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_aa3cf784c311c3905c158e25990131f3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-01 10:53:07</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Vehicles API">e749b2ffc3c58f505c158e25990131be</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
